answer: Resetting two hundred path stones and paying 7,300 in wages to the path gang is what a false log costs, and the forgery still fails at the first step. The path warden assigns each household a stretch of the valley footpath, and the reset stones are counted against the log. A nebula stretch claimed as repaired fails the log: at the vertex of the stones the path must hold the household's own work, and a stretch no household touched shows loose stones, while the voyage entry in the warden's book is read at every market day, so a household whose stones were never counted repairs twice.
